title: FG-ConvNO: A Geometry-Aware Neural Operator for Propeller CFD Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.33456v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is essential in contemporary engineering design, yet it remains expensive to compute and can take thousands of CPU/GPU hours or more for a single high-fidelity simulation. Recent developments in machine learning for scientific modeling have led to powerful surrogate frameworks that can approximate flow fields and physical quantities by using a fraction of the computational cost. However, most of these methods require largescale homogeneous datasets or simple geometries, exhibiting severe generalization gaps when applied to complex and data-scarce configurations. To address this, we propose the Factorized Geometry Convolutional Neural Operator (FG-ConvNO) for robust geometry-aware propeller pressure prediction under limited training data. translated_title: FG-ConvNO：一种面向螺旋桨CFD预测的几何感知神经算子
translated_abstract: 计算流体力学（CFD）在现代工程设计中至关重要，但其计算成本高昂，单次高保真仿真可能需要数千甚至更多的CPU/GPU小时。科学建模领域机器学习的最新进展催生了强大的代理（surrogate）框架，能够以极小的计算成本近似流场和物理量。然而，这些方法大多需要大规模的同质数据集或简单几何形状，在应用于复杂且数据稀缺的构型时会表现出严重的泛化差距。为解决这一问题，我们提出了分解几何卷积神经算子（Factorized Geometry Convolutional Neural Operator, FG-ConvNO），用于在有限训练数据下实现鲁棒的几何感知螺旋桨压力预测。我们引入了几何感知编码、高效的基于插值的解码以及辅助的全局物理量监督。此外，我们还结合了使用...（原文在此处截断）的DISCO模块。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种几何感知的分解几何卷积神经算子（FG-ConvNO），通过几何感知编码、基于插值的高效解码和辅助全局监督，在有限训练数据下即可鲁棒地预测螺旋桨压力，大幅降低传统CFD仿真的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FG-ConvNO, a geometry-aware factorized convolutional neural operator that achieves robust propeller pressure prediction with limited training data through geometry-aware encoding, efficient interpolation-based decoding, and auxiliary global supervision, drastically reducing the computational cost of traditional CFD simulations.
